source: CCMAS B.Sc. Medical Laboratory Science (khairun.edu.ng/?p=796); institution prefix removed from added courses; the two "Professional Examination" lines are examinations, not courses, and are left out.

courses.name: General Biology I
courses.general_name: Introductory Biology I: Cell Biology and Diversity of Life
courses.summary: Cell structure and function, biomolecules, genetics and heredity, evolution and the classification of living organisms.

courses.name: General Biology II
courses.general_name: Introductory Biology II: Physiology and Ecology
courses.summary: Plant and animal physiology, reproduction, ecology, ecosystems and environmental biology.

courses.name: General Practical Biology I
courses.summary: Microscopy, cell and tissue observation, dissections and basic biological techniques with drawings.

courses.name: General Practical Biology II
courses.summary: Practicals on plant and animal physiology, ecology sampling and identification.

courses.name: General Chemistry I
courses.general_name: Atomic Structure, Bonding and Physical Chemistry I
courses.summary: Atomic structure, periodic table, bonding, stoichiometry, states of matter, gas laws, thermochemistry and chemical equilibrium.

courses.name: General Chemistry II
courses.summary: Kinetics, electrochemistry, acids and bases, periodic trends, main-group chemistry, and introduction to organic compounds and reactions.

courses.name: General Practical Chemistry I
courses.summary: Safe lab practice, volumetric analysis, titrations, qualitative tests and simple physical-chemistry experiments.

courses.name: General Practical Chemistry II
courses.summary: Qualitative inorganic analysis, organic functional-group tests, kinetics and electrochemistry experiments.

courses.name: Introduction to Computing Sciences
courses.general_name: Introduction to Computer Science and Information Technology
courses.summary: History and generations of computers, hardware, software, operating systems, networks, number systems and the Internet, with productivity tools.

courses.name: Communication in English
courses.general_name: Academic English: Communication Skills and Writing
courses.summary: Listening, speaking, reading comprehension, grammar and usage, paragraph and essay writing, summary writing, and formal letters and reports.

courses.name: Nigerian Peoples and Culture
courses.general_name: Nigerian Peoples, Cultures and Heritage (African Studies)
courses.summary: Survey of Nigeria's major ethnic groups, pre-colonial states, colonial rule, religion, family, arts and the cultural values behind national identity and unity.

courses.name: Mathematics for Health Sciences
courses.summary: Algebra, calculus and dosage calculations for health students.

courses.name: General Physics I
courses.general_name: Introductory Mechanics and Properties of Matter
courses.summary: Units and dimensions, vectors, kinematics, Newton's laws, work, energy, momentum, rotational motion, gravitation, elasticity and fluids.

courses.name: General Physics II
courses.summary: Electric fields, potential, capacitance, DC circuits, magnetism, induction, AC basics, then waves and optics.

courses.name: General Practical Physics I
courses.summary: Measurement, error analysis and experiments in mechanics, heat and properties of matter, with report writing.

courses.name: General Practical Physics II
courses.summary: Experiments in electricity, magnetism, optics and waves, with graph work and error analysis.

courses.name: Anatomy of Upper and Lower Limb
courses.general_name: Anatomy of Upper and Lower Limb
courses.summary: Bones, muscles, nerves and vessels of the limbs.

courses.name: Histology of Basic Tissues
courses.summary: Microscopic structure of epithelial, connective, muscle and nervous tissue and its slide identification.

courses.name: General and Systemic Embryology
courses.summary: Embryo development: gametes to organ systems.

courses.name: General Biochemistry I
courses.general_name: Introductory Biochemistry I: Biomolecules and Enzymes
courses.summary: Structure and function of carbohydrates, lipids, amino acids, proteins and nucleic acids, plus enzyme basics.

courses.name: General Biochemistry II
courses.summary: Bioenergetics, glycolysis, TCA cycle, oxidative phosphorylation, lipid and amino-acid metabolism.

courses.name: General Biochemistry Practical
courses.summary: Qualitative and quantitative tests for biomolecules, spectrophotometry, enzyme assays and lab reports.

courses.name: Entrepreneurship and Innovation
courses.summary: Types of enterprise, opportunity spotting, business ideas, innovation, simple business plans, startup financing and the Nigerian small-business environment.

courses.name: Philosophy, Logic and Human Existence
courses.general_name: Introduction to Philosophy, Formal Logic and Ethics
courses.summary: Branches of philosophy, the nature of knowledge and existence, deductive and inductive reasoning, fallacies and argument analysis, and basic moral theory.

courses.name: Introduction to General Microbiology
courses.summary: Types of microbes, growth, control and diagnostic use.

courses.name: Introduction to Medical Laboratory Science
courses.summary: Laboratory disciplines, safety and professional ethics.

courses.name: History of Medical Laboratory Science
courses.summary: Evolution, regulation and ethics of the profession.

courses.name: Introduction to Biology of Diseases
courses.summary: Causes, mechanisms and classes of disease.

courses.name: Introductory Physiology and Blood
courses.summary: Body fluid compartments, blood composition, haemostasis, immunity and blood groups.

courses.name: Physiology of Excitable Tissues
courses.summary: Nerve and muscle excitation and contraction.

courses.name: Introduction to Cardiovascular and Respiratory Physiology
courses.general_name: Introduction to Cardiovascular and Respiratory Physiology
courses.summary: Heart, circulation, breathing and gas exchange.

courses.name: Gastrointestinal Physiology
courses.summary: Digestion, absorption and gut motility.

courses.name: Biostatistics
courses.summary: Probability, distributions, estimation, hypothesis testing, chi-square, regression and study design for health and biological data.

courses.name: Chemistry and Metabolism of Amino Acids and Proteins
courses.general_name: Chemistry and Metabolism of Amino Acids and Proteins
courses.summary: Amino-acid and protein structure and metabolism.

courses.name: Venture Creation
courses.summary: Turning an idea into a registered business: market research, business model, financing, legal registration, marketing and a start-up plan.

courses.name: Peace and Conflict Resolution
courses.summary: Causes and types of conflict, Nigerian conflict case studies, negotiation, mediation, arbitration, and peace-building institutions.

courses.name: Basic Clinical Chemistry
courses.summary: Analytical principles, specimen handling and common tests.

courses.name: Basic Haematology
courses.summary: Blood cells, counts, film examination and anaemias.

courses.name: Basic Microbiology
courses.summary: Culture, staining and identification of clinical isolates.

courses.name: Basic Histopathology

courses.name: Basic Immunology

courses.name: Practical Exercise I
courses.summary: Hands-on practicals across lab disciplines.

courses.name: Fundamentals of Blood Group Serology

courses.name: Basic Medical Parasitology and Entomology
courses.summary: Parasites, vectors and laboratory diagnosis.

courses.name: Biomedical Engineering
courses.summary: Medical devices, instrumentation and laboratory equipment.

courses.name: Molecular Biology and Microbial Genetics
courses.summary: Bacterial and viral genetics, gene transfer, mutation, gene regulation and recombinant DNA techniques.

courses.name: Forensic Science
courses.summary: Forensic evidence, analysis and expert testimony.

courses.name: Medical Laboratory Bio-risk Management
courses.summary: Biosafety, waste handling and laboratory risk.

courses.name: Bio-manufacturing and In-vitro Diagnostic Reagents
courses.summary: Production and quality control of diagnostic reagents.

courses.name: General Pharmacology

courses.name: Systemic Pharmacology
courses.summary: Drugs acting on organ systems: cardiovascular, respiratory, gastrointestinal, renal and endocrine.

courses.name: General Pathology
courses.summary: Cell injury, inflammation, repair, neoplasia, haemodynamic disorders and general disease mechanisms.

courses.name: Basic Pharmacology and Toxicology
courses.summary: Drug action, toxicity and laboratory monitoring.

courses.name: Character Building, Professionalism and Team Work in Healthcare
courses.general_name: Character Building, Professionalism and Team Work in Healthcare

courses.name: Medical Laboratory Histopathology I

courses.name: Medical Laboratory Microbiology I
courses.summary: Bacteriology and diagnostic methods.

courses.name: Laboratory Instrumentation and Techniques
courses.summary: Spectrophotometry, chromatography and analysers.

courses.name: Research Methodology

courses.name: Practical Exercise II
courses.summary: Advanced laboratory practicals.

courses.name: Laboratory Posting II
courses.summary: Clinical lab rotation, specialised sections.

courses.name: Clinical Chemistry I
courses.summary: Carbohydrate, lipid, protein and enzyme tests.

courses.name: Blood Group Serology
courses.summary: Transfusion immunology and cross-matching.

courses.name: Professional Ethics in Medical Laboratory Science
courses.general_name: Professional Ethics in Medical Laboratory Science
courses.summary: Professional conduct, confidentiality and regulation.

courses.name: Medical Laboratory Supply Chain Management
courses.summary: Procurement, stock control and cold chain.

courses.name: Molecular Diagnostics and Bioinformatics
